# Vibe Coding Repository Standard

> An open-source repository operating standard, starter template, validator, and multi-agent workflow for understandable, testable, and maintainable software development with AI coding agents.

VCRS is agent-compatible at the principles level and Codex-first in the current reference implementation. It does not guarantee production readiness, security, compatibility across all agents, or search visibility.
